name: SVR Poker Android
updateMessage: An optional SVR Poker Android update is available.
updateMenuPolicy: Hidden unless releaseReady is true, apkUrl is non-empty, and apkVersionCode is newer than the installed code.
notes: Phase 354 adds a browser-level Android acceptance runner for SIT, one controller, hole cards, community cards, legal actions, showdown, pot settlement, chip conservation, and next-hand restart.
A passing hand must reach five community cards, produce at least one winner, preserve exactly 6,000 total table chips, and advance to the next hand.
The acceptance runtime repairs Android card-slot text directly from the Phase 336 authoritative state without introducing another HUD or controller.
Phase 350 still physically removes every legacy Android controller root and external virtual stick.
Phase 347 still owns the single MOVE, LOOK, seated-slide, action, logo, and pot-display presentation.
Phase 336 remains the local six-seat poker rules and settlement authority.
This release is a local play-money game against bots; server-authoritative internet poker is not claimed.
No native Android wrapper source, signing identity, or installable RC2 APK is currently present in the repository.
Forced updates and recurring update prompts remain disabled.
